name: PTU Combat Quick Curl + Defense Curl

ability.name: Quick Curl
ability.effect: Connection - Defense Curl; activate Quick Curl to use Defense Curl as a Swift Action

move.name: Defense Curl
move.existing_runtime: critical immunity, DR 10, Slowed/Accuracy interactions, Rollout/Ice Ball exceptions remain owned by the existing Combat condition model

composite_policy.standard_to_swift: allowed only through the shared ledger when Swift is spent and Standard remains available
composite_policy.ordinary_defense_curl: unchanged and still uses its normal Move path/action cost
composite_policy.transactions: Ability and overridden Move action create separate namespaced transactions linked by compositeId
composite_policy.refund: resource-only Undo may correct either spend independently and never clears Curled Up

source_guards: Quick Curl effect signature must match the audited Core wording.
Defense Curl must remain At-Will/Self and match the audited Curled Up effect signature.
